description: This file defines the class DetailViewMetaParser, which extends MetaParser and provides functionality to parse HTML files of DetailView from SugarCRM versions prior to 5.x, converting them into metadata format. It includes methods for processing HTML content, handling specific module cases, and merging panel data.

classes.name: DetailViewMetaParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing DetailView HTML files from older SugarCRM versions and converting them into metadata format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the view type to 'DetailView'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a DetailView HTML file, process its content, and produce metadata output, with options to merge with existing metadata.
